cohort: Preterm infants born at <37 weeks of gestation and staying in the neonatal intensive care unit or visiting an outpatient clinic for a one-month checkup between April 2020 and March 2022
finding: Japanese preterm infants at one month of age had a lower cephalic index and a higher incidence of dolichocephaly compared to term infants.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as a risk factor for dolichocephaly in preterm infants.
